patch.summary: Lusha implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Lusha by mapping current sales-intelligence workflows to Lusha objects, confirming plan gates for lead scoring (Starter, Pro, Premium, Scale), workflow automation (Pro, Premium, Scale), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: lead scoring (Starter, Pro, Premium, Scale)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Salesforce

blocks.heading: Lusha day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Lusha setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for prospecting, data enrichment, contact management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves SDR/BDR teams needing verified emails/dials and enrichment before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Salesforce and HubSpot before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover lead scoring (Starter, Pro, Premium, Scale)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.
Do not expand seats until prospecting is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Not a full CRM pipeline/deal system — buyers still need a CRM of record for pipeline hygiene.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Credit-based consumption for reveals/signals/API; unused annual credits do not roll over.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: API access and some connectors are plan-gated (Pro+ / Scale nuances documented).

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Phone reveals cost more credits than emails; high-volume phone prospecting can burn credits quickly.

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Lusha plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.
